texturas.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: repeatable color texture for a lightweight Three.js 3D museum exterior wall. Primary request: a seamless tileable square diffuse albedo texture of weathered sandstone masonry typical of a historic museum building in western India. Fine natural limestone/sandstone grain, subtle warm gray and ochre mineral variation, faint age marks and patina, a few delicate horizontal stone joints, physically believable scale. Straight-on orthographic surface scan, evenly lit, no shadows, no perspective, no building, no windows, no objects, no text, no watermark. The left/right and top/bottom edges should match for tiling. High detail but low contrast so it reads as real stone from a distance.

texturas.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless diffuse albedo texture for interior walls of a walkable Three.js museum about Hinduism. Primary request: a square, seamlessly tileable close-up surface texture of aged deep terracotta and muted burgundy lime plaster, with subtle hand-troweled mineral variation, faint worn pigment and authentic historic Indian museum atmosphere. Straight-on orthographic flat surface scan, evenly lit without directional shadows. Restrained detail and low contrast so artworks and signage remain readable in front of it. No bricks, no architecture, no columns, no ornaments, no objects, no text, no watermark. Left/right and top/bottom edges must match for tiling.

texturas.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless diffuse albedo texture for the walkable floor of a historic Indian museum in Three.js. Primary request: a square, tileable close-up of worn pale buff sandstone and warm gray limestone flooring, very subtle cream and taupe mineral veins, natural pores and age, physically plausible museum stone. No grout lines or separate slabs because the 3D scene already has tile joints. Straight-on orthographic flat surface scan, evenly lit without directional shadows. Low contrast and not yellow; quietly elegant. No architecture, no objects, no text, no watermark. Left/right and top/bottom edges should match for repeated tiling.
